CustomField.description: Used by "HELP DESK TICKET | subflow: email alerts" flow logic; returns FALSE if the ticket was opened on the weekend or outside office hours on a weekday
CustomField.formula: IF( AND( Time_Opened__c >= TIMEVALUE( "08:30:00.000" ), Time_Opened__c <= TIMEVALUE( "17:00:00.000" ), Opened_on_What_Day__c != "Saturday", Opened_on_What_Day__c != "Sunday" ), TRUE, FALSE )
CustomField.label: Opened During Office Hours
